_comment: Single source of truth for the waste transport planner: container sizes, truck types with their loading rules, and the company site. A rule is a maximal allowed load written in the company's notation (eN = empty N m3 container, fN = full N m3 container, '2f6 + 1e2' = two full 6 and one empty 2); anything smaller than a listed load is allowed too. Used by frontend/public/waste_model.js (via frontend/server.js), scripts/waste_capacity_check.py and referenced by the docs.

company.description: company site: trucks start and end the day here

materials._comment: materials are sold as a full truck: nothing else on board during that trip
